context:
Goal: triage 11's goal reads as met, not stuck on a wording mismatch.
Problem (rule): the goal text says the step about triage merging its own green PRs (step standing-merges-own-green-pr) lands your 19:05 CST Nov 17 grant "into CLAUDE.md", but that step was dropped and the grant sits in the session-tiers bullet (decision session-tiers, the record of what each session role may do) that PR 3639 (the hook merge) landed; the goal check keeps reading gap 2 as unmet, and only you can reword the goal or add a second home.
Based on (read): the merge tool already lets triage merge only a PR it opened, once its checks pass, and code changes also need a passing Sonnet review on record; it sets no limit on size. The coordinator and an audit agent read it, and it is noted on the step at 20:30 CST Nov 17.
Based on (ruling): the coordinator's 23:36 CST Nov 17 relay: leave the step dropped; the session-tiers bullet is the grant's home, because a ruling lives in its decision record; it made no CLAUDE.md edit and will not. A coordinator pick, not owner-typed.
Departs from: main — the goal text names CLAUDE.md as the grant's home; this changes the goal wording or adds a second home.
Waiting on: nothing is stopped; triage keeps gap 2 closed as dropped until you answer.
home: triage 11 goal text, gap 2 (the dropped step about triage merging its own green PRs)

options.gain: The goal check stops flagging gap 2, and there is one place to change the grant later.
options.how: You edit the /goal text so step 2 reads closed: the grant lives in decision session-tiers (landed by PR 3639, the hook merge).
options.label: Reword the goal: gap 2 is closed, the grant's home is the session-tiers bullet
options.lose: You edit the goal text once.

options.gain: The goal's literal wording is met.
options.how: You or the consultant add one line to the global CLAUDE.md naming the standing merge grant.
options.label: Also add one CLAUDE.md line carrying the grant
options.lose: Two places that can disagree about what triage may merge. Triage does not edit CLAUDE.md.

options.how: Nothing changes; the goal check keeps reporting gap 2 unmet.
options.label: Leave the goal as is
options.lose: The goal can never read as met while gap 2 is dropped.

reply: Closed. You picked a. Goal v3 is cleared and goal v4 (briefs/triage-11-goal-v4.md) has no gap 2; the grant's home is the session-tiers bullet.

shown.label: Reword the goal: gap 2 is closed, the grant's home is the session-tiers bullet
Also add one CLAUDE.md line carrying the grant

title: Where should the merge grant live: the session-tiers bullet, or also CLAUDE.md?
why: a keeps one home for the grant and ends the false unmet reading; b adds a second home that can drift. The coordinator also advised rewording the goal text.
